name: Mindstrong
short_description: Mindstrong was a digital mental health company using smartphone biomarkers to monitor mental health. The company is now defunct.
long_description: Mindstrong was a venture-backed digital mental health startup that developed technology to detect mental health biomarkers through smartphone usage patterns like typing speed and screen interactions. The company raised over $100 million in funding and partnered with health systems to provide virtual mental health care. However, Mindstrong shut down operations in 2023 after struggling to prove the clinical validity of its biomarker technology and facing financial difficulties. The company's closure represents one of the more notable failures in the digital mental health space.
one_liner: Defunct digital mental health company that used smartphone biomarkers (closed 2023).
